original_datasets.name: AEJApp-2009-0289 household and tables
original_datasets.notes: Main analysis uses household.dta; table2.dta is used to cross-check and merge domhigh. Key variables: hhcode (ID), domlow (village low-caste dominant=1, high-caste=0), totinc (total income), village (cluster), domhigh (from table2). The review notes 1295 households across 90 villages; two hhcodes appear in table2 but not in household.dta.

tasks.task_instruction: Conduct the analysis without any restrictions.

analysis_path.path_description: Import original data; verify table consistency; compute skewness/kurtosis and Mahalanobis outliers; identify six outlying villages; fit multilevel model (random intercept by village) and OLS of total income on domlow for full data and excluding six outlying villages.
preprocessing_steps: Left join domhigh from table2.dta into household data by hhcode.
Create village_factor as string-coded village identifier.
Compute skewness and kurtosis for totinc.
Compute Mahalanobis distance using [domlow, totinc] with chi-square p < 0.001 to flag potential outliers.
Identify six outlying villages based on mixed-model residual diagnostics (villages: 70, 61, 60, 84, 59, 58).
Create two datasets: full data; data excluding the six outlying villages.

key_choices.main_predictor_measure: Village-level low-caste domination indicator (domlow; 1=low-caste dominated; 0=high-caste dominated).
key_choices.sample_restriction: None for main analysis; second specification excludes villages 70, 61, 60, 84, 59, 58.
key_choices.outlier_rule: Flag household-level outliers via Mahalanobis p < 0.001; outlying villages based on mixed-model residual diagnostics (pre-specified six villages).
key_choices.missing_data_rule: Listwise deletion on variables used in each model.
key_choices.data_processing: Merge auxiliary domhigh from table2; convert village to factor-like string; construct exclusion set of outlying villages.
key_choices.model_choice: Linear mixed-effects model with random intercept for village; OLS as robustness.
key_choices.inference_rule: Two-sided p-value for domlow coefficient (alpha=0.05) with 95% confidence interval.

main_predictor.name: domlow
main_predictor.definition: Indicator for whether the village is low-caste dominated (1) or high-caste dominated (0).

analysis_code.notes: Python translation of the provided R script. Reads /app/data/AEJApp-2009-0289-data/household.dta and table2.dta, performs multilevel (MixedLM) and OLS, and writes /app/data/analysis_results.json.

tasks.notes_for_agent: Follow this planned path; do not change the focal claim, dataset, or analysis goal.

tasks.task_instruction: Do not include District, Crop, Distance, Groundwater, Public goods controls. Do not include irrigation, credit, and tenancy variables, their interactions, or instruments for water buyer status. Report a main result in standard test-family terms.

analysis_path.path_description: Use the same data preparation as Task1, then fit OLS predicting totinc from domlow (no additional controls) on full data and excluding six outlying villages. Report t-test results.
preprocessing_steps: Left join domhigh from table2.dta by hhcode.
Create village_factor; compute skewness, kurtosis; compute Mahalanobis outliers.
Identify six outlying villages (70, 61, 60, 84, 59, 58) and prepare full vs. excluded datasets.

key_choices.sample_restriction: None for main analysis; a secondary specification excludes villages 70, 61, 60, 84, 59, 58.
key_choices.outlier_rule: Mahalanobis p < 0.001 screening; village-level exclusion as per residual diagnostics.
key_choices.missing_data_rule: Listwise deletion on variables in the model.
key_choices.data_processing: Merge domhigh; convert village to factor-like string; construct exclusion set.
key_choices.inference_rule: t-test and p-value for domlow coefficient with 95% confidence interval.

main_predictor.name: domlow
main_predictor.definition: Indicator for village low-caste domination (1) vs high-caste (0).

analysis_code.notes: Same entrypoint as Task1; the script outputs both MixedLM and OLS results to /app/data/analysis_results.json; Task2 uses the OLS outputs.

tasks.notes_for_agent: Use the planned OLS path without adding controls or instruments; report standard test statistics.

files.data/r_script_clean_code__py.py: Python translation of the provided R analysis. Performs data import/merge, normality and Mahalanobis checks, identifies six outlying villages, fits MixedLM and OLS on full and reduced datasets, and writes JSON results to /app/data/analysis_results.json.

codebase.notes: Entry is a single Python script expecting data under /app/data/AEJApp-2009-0289-data. Ensure the volume mount places the data directory at /app/data.

analysis.instructions: Execute Task1 and Task2 using the original dataset. Run the Python script to produce analysis_results.json and extract MixedLM and OLS coefficients, SEs, CIs, p-values, and sample sizes for domlow on totinc for both full data and the dataset excluding six outlying villages.
not_allowed_actions: replace the planned path with a different analysis path

debugging_rule.repair_scope: fix dependency, file path, or output extraction issues only; do not redesign the analysis.

analysis.comparison_metrics: For MixedLM and OLS: domlow coefficient, standard error, 95% CI, p-value, test statistic (z for MixedLM; t for OLS), sample size, AIC/BIC when available, and conclusion text regarding significance on full vs. excluded-villages datasets.
